summary: Iteration 17: Tested Past Paper System (upload/bulk-upload/browse/filters/stats/update/bulk-approve/delete), Global Search API, Student Dashboard redesign, Past Paper Library page, Admin Past Papers tab, dual navigation. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. Frontend: All data-testids present and functional for authenticated flows.

issues: Public nav shows only 'Store | About | Contact' — spec requires 'Learn | Store | Community | About | Contact'. Missing 'Learn' and 'Community' links for logged-out users.

action_items: Add 'Learn' and 'Community' links to public (unauthenticated) navigation in Header.js to match spec.
critical_code_review_comments: past_papers_api.py upload endpoint: resource_type default 'question_paper' logic is asymmetric — if user explicitly passes 'question_paper', it gets overridden by inference. Consider using an Optional[str] = None sentinel for cleaner override semantics.

search_api.py: past_paper subtitle formatting uses .upper()/.title() on possibly empty strings — works but produces trailing separators like ' · ·  P' when metadata is sparse. Consider joining only truthy parts.
past_papers_api.py bulk_upload: no per-file size or content-type validation; a corrupt/huge file could break the batch. Consider try/except per file with error entries in the result.
seed_data_creation: Tests upload dummy PDFs (0580_s24_qp_22.pdf, 0620_w23_ms_31.pdf, 0625_m22_qp_12.pdf); 0580 paper is soft-deleted by delete test. Remaining 0620 and 0625 papers persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 features (past papers + global search + dashboard redesign + admin PP tab) all pass. Only outstanding item: public nav is missing Learn and Community links. Backend pytest suite at test_iter17_past_papers_search.py has 13 tests covering the full CRUD + search flow.
